2) Follow with a dedicated capacity sizing call (throughput/latency deep-dive) — we'd like engineers from your side plus our SE to review load profile and reserve a preliminary GPU pool.
3) Share any sample production traces or a small synthetic load CSV ahead of the sizing call (helps us draft a preliminary footprint).
